personal_bundles.name: morbidium-spritesheets
personal_bundles.description: Create consistent animated 2D character sprite sheets, paper-doll art, and effect sheets for the Morbidium Three.js game, with frame validation, atlases, metadata, visual QA, and a handoff Claude can integrate. Use for requests to animate a Morbidium character, make a spritesheet/spriteark, add directional walk/attack/death frames, or prepare game-ready figure art for Claude.
personal_bundles.source: Eksisterende personlig skill, kopiert uten endringer
